speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति ।
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति ।
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
iast:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti |
viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ |
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti |
tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye ||
english: What the knowers of the Veda call the Imperishable, what ascetics free of passion enter, and for which people live a life of celibacy: that goal I will describe to you briefly.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥
iast:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca |
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām ||
english: Closing all the gates of the body, holding the mind in the heart, drawing the life-breath into the head, established in yogic concentration,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran |
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
english: uttering Om, the one-syllable Brahman, and remembering me, whoever departs, leaving the body, reaches the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
iast:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ |
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ ||
english: For one who remembers me constantly, day after day, with a mind that turns to nothing else, I am easy to reach, son of Pritha, for that ever-disciplined yogi.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
iast:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam |
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ||
english: Having come to me, these great souls, who have reached the highest perfection, do not return to rebirth, the impermanent home of sorrow.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
iast:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna |
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate ||
english: All worlds, up to the world of Brahmā, return again, Arjuna; but for one who comes to me, son of Kunti, there is no rebirth.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥
iast:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ |
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ ||
english: Those who know that a day of Brahmā lasts a thousand ages, and a night of Brahmā a thousand ages, are people who truly know day and night.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥
iast:
avyaktādvyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame |
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake ||
english: At the coming of that day, all manifest things emerge from the unmanifest; at the coming of night, they dissolve into that same thing called the unmanifest.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥
iast:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate |
rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame ||
english: This same multitude of beings, coming into being again and again, dissolves helplessly at the coming of night, son of Pritha, and arises again at the coming of day.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
iast:
parastasmāttu bhāvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktātsanātanaḥ |
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ||
english: But beyond that unmanifest is another, eternal unmanifest reality, which does not perish when all beings perish.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
iast:
avyakto'kṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim |
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama ||
english: This unmanifest is called the Imperishable; it is called the highest goal. Those who reach it do not return: that is my supreme abode.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥
iast:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā |
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam ||
english: That supreme Person, son of Pritha, is reached by undivided devotion; in him all beings dwell, and by him all this is pervaded.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ |
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ||
english: Now I will tell you, best of the Bharatas, of the times at which yogis who depart either do not return or do return.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
iast:
agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam |
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ ||
english: Fire, light, day, the bright half of the month, the six months of the sun's northern course: departing by these, people who know Brahman go to Brahman.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥
iast:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam |
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate ||
english: Smoke, night, the dark half of the month, the six months of the sun's southern course: by these the yogi reaches the light of the moon and returns.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ॥
iast:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate |
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ ||
english: These two paths, the bright and the dark, are held to be the world's eternal ways: by one a person goes and does not return; by the other a person comes back again.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥
iast:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana |
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna ||
english: Knowing these two paths, son of Pritha, no yogi is ever confused. So at all times be disciplined in yoga, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव ।
दानेषु यत् पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा ।
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
iast:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva |
dāneṣu yat puṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam |
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā |
yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam ||
english: Whatever fruit of merit is promised for the Vedas, for sacrifices, austerities and gifts, the yogi who knows this goes beyond all of it and reaches the supreme, original state.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
iast:
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave |
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt ||
english: To you, who do not find fault, I will now reveal this most secret knowledge, together with realised wisdom; knowing it, you will be freed from all that is harmful.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam |
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam ||
english: It is the king of knowledge, the king of secrets, the supreme purifier, known by direct experience, in keeping with dharma, very easy to practise, and imperishable.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
iast:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa |
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani ||
english: People who have no faith in this dharma, scorcher of enemies, do not reach me but return to the path of death and worldly existence.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥
iast:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā |
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ ||
english: All this world is pervaded by me in my unmanifest form. All beings dwell in me, but I do not dwell in them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
iast:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram |
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||
english: And yet beings do not dwell in me: see my divine power! My self sustains all beings and brings them into being, yet does not dwell in them.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥
iast:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān |
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya ||
english: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in space, so all beings rest in me: understand this.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām |
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham ||
english: At the end of a cosmic age, son of Kunti, all beings return to my nature; at the beginning of an age, I send them forth again.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
iast:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt ||
english: Taking hold of my own nature, I send forth again and again this whole multitude of beings, helpless under the power of nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
iast:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya |
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu ||
english: These actions do not bind me, Arjuna, for I sit as if indifferent, unattached to these actions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
iast:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram |
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate ||
english: Under my supervision, nature gives birth to all that moves and does not move; because of this, son of Kunti, the world turns.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
iast:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram ||
english: Fools disregard me when I take on a human body, not knowing my higher nature as the great Lord of all beings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
iast:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ |
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ ||
english: Their hopes in vain, their actions in vain, their knowledge in vain, senseless, they take on the deluding nature of rakshasas and asuras.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ |
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam ||
english: But great souls, son of Pritha, who take on the divine nature, worship me with undivided minds, knowing me as the imperishable source of beings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
iast:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ |
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate ||
english: Always singing my praise, striving with firm resolve, and bowing to me in devotion, they worship me, ever disciplined.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
iast:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate |
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham ||
english: Others, offering the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me as the One, as distinct, and in many ways, as the one whose face is everywhere.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
iast:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham |
mantro'hamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam ||
english: I am the ritual, I am the sacrifice, I am the offering to the ancestors, I am the healing herb; I am the sacred chant, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥
iast:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ |
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca ||
english: I am the father of this world, its mother, its sustainer and its grandfather; I am what is to be known, the purifier, the syllable Om, and the Rig, Sama and Yajur Vedas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt |
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam ||
english: I am the goal, the support, the lord, the witness, the home, the refuge and the friend; the origin, the dissolution and the ground, the treasure-house and the imperishable seed.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥
iast:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca |
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna ||
english: I give heat; I hold back the rain and send it forth. I am immortality and also death, being and non-being, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा ।
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक- ।
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
iast:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā |
yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante |
te puṇyamāsādya surendraloka- |
maśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān ||
english: Those who know the three Vedas, who drink the soma and are cleansed of sin, worship me with sacrifices and pray for the way to heaven; reaching the holy world of the lord of the gods, they enjoy the divine pleasures of the gods in heaven.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं ।
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना ।
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
iast:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ |
kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti |
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā |
gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante ||
english: Having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they return to the world of mortals when their merit is spent; following the dharma of the three Vedas and wanting pleasures, they come and go.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham ||
english: Those who think of no one else and worship me, always disciplined, I bring them what they lack and protect what they have.
